purpose: Validate the user-proposed seven-variable CAD domain against the V6 parameterization adapter. Values are tested in isolated copies only; no Flow project or solver is run.

c_mm.meaning: 轴向偏心距；基准值 32 mm 的 -10%～+10%

e_mm.meaning: 径向偏心距；基准值 3.7 mm 的 -10%～+10%

alpha_deg.meaning: 全锥角；对应物理半锥角 10°～20°

Dmax_mm.meaning: 密封锥底圆 Dmax；下界由 2026-09-22 二分实测改定（见 notes）

notes: alpha_deg is the full cone angle in the external design JSON. The CAD adapter writes alpha_deg/2 into the four half-angle sketches.
A CAD pass means the isolated V6 copy reports completed=true and physical_mapping_verified=true after rebuild, save, reopen, geometric readback, and assembly feature checks.
Flow lids, Flow project creation, meshing, and solver execution are intentionally excluded from this range-validation pass.

Dmax_mm.lower was 179.9 and failed CAD: the inverse-solved internal cone diameter drops to about s=159.14 mm and 10压板.SLPRT feature 切除-旋转2 fails to rebuild (error 71). Bisection along the baseline path found the last verified pass at 183.99772 mm and the first verified failure at 183.99214 mm (0.01 mm resolution). 184.1 is the conservative production bound with 0.1 mm of margin; it is not itself a bisected result.
The Dmax lower bound above was measured with the other six variables at baseline. Whether it still holds at the low end of alpha_deg is exactly what the Dmax_mm x alpha_deg corner cases test.
